subject.title: Add persistent cron job execution history with filtering

question: Should OpenClaw expand cron history beyond current SQLite `cron.runs` into timestamp-filtered CLI/protocol/UI/export/summary/retention controls, and which pieces belong in core now?
rationale: The remaining request crosses public API, CLI, docs, config, retention, and security/audit boundaries, and the issue is already marked for maintainer and product review rather than automatic repair.

options.title: Narrow Core History Upgrade
options.body: Add timestamp filters and a documented CLI/API/UI history path on top of existing SQLite storage, while treating day-retention/manual prune/export details as explicit follow-up decisions.

options.title: Full Audit Surface
options.body: Implement the broader acceptance list now, including export/follow, success-rate aggregates, and manual retention controls, accepting a larger security and compatibility review surface.

options.title: Close As Out Of Scope
options.body: Keep only the current durable `cron.runs` surface and document that richer audit/export workflows belong outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Narrow Core History Upgrade
recommendation.body: Add timestamp filters and a documented CLI/API/UI history path on top of existing SQLite storage, while treating day-retention/manual prune/export details as explicit follow-up decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: The current durable cron history path and recent cron server/protocol work most directly trace to steipete's history.
